purpose: Short T14 synthetic Firefox slow-receiver isolation smoke using a bounded Playwright application-layer downlink hold.

runtime.firefox: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10.15; rv:157.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/157.0

tls.trust: local CA imported only into isolated Firefox NSS profiles and supplied to the HTTPS catalogue request

topology.syntheticSources: host page only: oscillator/AudioContext stream and animated canvas stream; no physical microphone or display capture

disturbance.scope: slow receiver only; Playwright WebSocketRoute server-to-browser application layer
disturbance.delivery: hold downlink messages until the oldest queued message reaches 500 ms; do not replay held messages

driver.transportLayer: Playwright WebSocketRoute server-to-browser application layer; not TCP packet shaping

transport.scope: application WebSocket send callback; excludes OS/TCP queues and peer receipt

limits.transportClaim: The injected hold is an application-layer Playwright route. It is not TCP shaping, packet loss, physical network age, or a real browser background transition.
limits.networkAndDeviceClaims: No physical microphone, human listening, phone, OS backgrounding, packet-loss, bandwidth, p95, endurance, capacity, or Cloud Run claim.
limits.serverBuffer: The route driver queue is separate from the server application send budget; server policy is covered by its Node contract seam.
limits.autoplay: No autoplay preferences are changed. If playback is suspended, the visible ordinary continue-listening button is clicked and actual AudioWorklet samples are still required.
